claim: LevelProgram and PlanarLayout seat what is stood on a floor by the box the renderer draws only when they are given tile_extents (picnum to pixel height and picanm yofs). Without it a placement's z is put on its anchor: an enemy, whose art is offset, stands buried to the waist, and nothing is raised at compile time.
evidence: projects/cold-store, 2026-11-26: three cultists placed with layout.place_on_floor were reported by the gate sprite_fit.sunk_actors as 50% under their floor; with LevelProgram(tile_extents=sprite_tile_extents()) the gate was clean
bloodmap/planar_layout.py place_on_floor: seat is set to floor only if self.tile_extents
use: Build a level program with art_sizes=rules.art_sizes() AND tile_extents=texture_align.sprite_tile_extents() (the starter does). A tile whose art is drawn centred then needs cstat 128, or compile refuses it as below the floor.
